formulas.total_operating_expenses: transaction_expense + transaction_and_credit_losses + customer_support_and_operations + sales_and_marketing + technology_and_development + general_and_administrative + restructuring_and_other

net_revenues_yoy.description: Total net revenue YoY growth rate vs 2025Q1

transaction_expense_margin_delta_bps.description: Transaction expense as a percentage of net revenues, delta bps vs 2025Q1

transaction_and_credit_losses_margin_del.description: Transaction and credit losses as a percentage of net revenues, delta bps vs 2025Q1

customer_support_and_operations_yoy.description: Customer support and operations expense YoY growth rate vs 2025Q1

sales_and_marketing_yoy.description: Sales and marketing expense YoY growth rate vs 2025Q1

technology_and_development_yoy.description: Technology and development expense YoY growth rate vs 2025Q1

general_and_administrative_yoy.description: general_and_administrative YoY growth rate vs Q-4

restructuring_and_other_abs.description: restructuring_and_other absolute dollar value for the target quarter (predict the amount directly; 0 if none expected)

other_income_net_abs.description: other_income_net absolute dollar value for the target quarter (predict the amount directly; 0 if none expected)

tax_rate.description: Effective GAAP tax rate for the target quarter (decimal, e.g. 0.14 = 14%; may be negative in a benefit quarter). Choose from the GAAP historical anchors provided; a discrete tax item can push it far from any of them.

shares_abs.description: shares: diluted weighted-average share count for the target quarter (predict the count directly; drifts slowly with buybacks/issuance).
